title: Pricing
summary: Openslot pricing: a free plan with no card, Pro from $12 per user per month, Team from $25, and Enterprise with SSO and audit logs.
heading: Pay for the people who host meetings
text: Start free and stay free if one booking page is all you need. Every paid plan has a 14-day Team trial with no card.

plans.name: Free
plans.text: One booking page, for one person who just needs a link.

plans.name: Pro
plans.text: For one person or a small team who books all day.

plans.name: Team
plans.text: For teams where a booking has to reach the right person.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.text: For organizations with procurement and a security review.

note: Prices are per user, per month, and exclude tax. The Team trial runs for 14 days and does not ask for a card.

faq.question: Is the free plan really free?
faq.answer: Yes. One booking page, one calendar and email reminders, with no card and no time limit. The page carries a small Openslot mark, which paid plans remove.

faq.question: How does the trial work?
faq.answer: The Team trial runs for 14 days and does not ask for a card. When it ends, the workspace drops to Free rather than locking you out, and your booking pages keep their links.

faq.question: What does billing yearly save?
faq.answer: Twenty percent. Pro is $12 per user per month billed yearly against $15 billed monthly, and Team is $25 against $31.

faq.question: What counts as a user?
faq.answer: Anyone whose calendar Openslot reads to work out availability. People who only receive bookings through a team page and never host are not charged.

faq.question: Can we change plan mid-month?
faq.answer: Yes, in either direction. Upgrades take effect straight away and are prorated. Downgrades take effect at the end of the period you have already paid for.

faq.question: What is in Enterprise?
faq.answer: Everything in Team, plus single sign-on, an audit log, a choice of data residency and a named support contact. Pricing depends on size, so it starts with a conversation.

closing.heading: Try Team for 14 days
closing.text: No card, no sales call, and nothing locks when the trial ends. The workspace drops to Free and your links keep working.
closing.note: Cancel any time, from inside the app.
